newsitem.title: USA: Georgia revenue rise 2.1 percent in January.
newsitem.headline: Georgia revenue rise 2.1 percent in January.

text.p: Georgia revenue collections totaled $952.8 million in January, an increase of $19.7 million or 2.1 percent over January of last year, acting Revenue Commissioner Jerry Jackson said.
Collections for the fiscal year to date were $5.95 billion, an increase of $406.7 million or 7.3 percent over the same period last year. The fiscal year began July 1.

For the year to date, sales and usage taxes have risen five percent, individual income tax collectison have risen 11.1 percent and corporate income taxes were up by 3.8 percent over the same period last year.
